info.title: API.SH: Lazada
info.description: The Lazada API from API.SH: public Lazada data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Products of one Lazada category (Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Philippines, Vietnam or Indonesia): name, price, discount, rating, review count, seller, location, image and link, with the sort options and filters the page offers. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/lazada-category

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category slug from a Lazada category link (for example shop-laptops), or the link itself.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Lazada site: sg (default), my, th, ph, vn, id.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: popularity (default), price_asc or price_desc.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Lowest price, whole units of the local currency.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Highest price, whole units of the local currency.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; it is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Lazada product: title, brand, price, currency, stock, seller id, category, images, variant options and every variant (options, SKU id, URL, image) and the description text and images. The country comes from the URL domain.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/lazada-product

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A Lazada product URL (lazada.sg, lazada.com.my, lazada.co.th, lazada.com.ph, lazada.vn, lazada.co.id).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Customer reviews of one Lazada product (Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Philippines, Vietnam or Indonesia): rating, text, review time, purchase date, buyer (masked by the site), verified purchase, likes, variant, review photos and videos and seller replies, with the product's average rating, rating and review counts and the 5..1 star breakdown. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/lazada-reviews

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: Product id (the number after -i in a product link, or `id` from /lazada/v1/search). Either item_id or url is required.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Lazada site for item_id: sg (default), my, th, ph, vn, id. With url, the site comes from the link.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A Lazada product link (https://www.lazada.sg/products/...-i123456789.html).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default) or newest.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with this star rating (1-5).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Reviews per page, 1-50 (default 20).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.title: ASUS Vivobook Go 14 E1404FA-EB1791W 14" Laptop (AMD Ryzen 3 | AMD Radeon Graphics | 8GB/256GB) 2026 NEW

reviews.text: Item is original and I find it v nice. Ordered another one for my son. Hope it will last long...
Item well received as described. Box was sealed and PC arrived in good condition. Package was double sealed as well.

get.description:
Products for a search on Lazada (Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Philippines, Vietnam, Indonesia): title, price, original price, discount, rating, reviews count, units sold, seller, brand, location, stock, badges and images, 40 per page, plus the filters Lazada offers for the search. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page. Optional facet filters `brand`, `location` (shipped from) and `service` take the `value` strings listed in the response's `filters`; `lazmall` and `free_shipping` are shortcuts for those services. `applied_filters` echoes them.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/lazada-search

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Lazada country site (default sg).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Lowest price, whole units of the local currency.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Highest price, whole units of the local currency.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand filter values from the response's filters (brand), comma separated.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Shipped-from filter values from the response's filters (location), comma separated.

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: Service and promotion filter values from the response's filters (service), comma separated.

parameters.name: lazmall
parameters.description: LazMall (official store) products only.

parameters.name: free_shipping
parameters.description: Products with free shipping only.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Lazada seller store: name, seller rating, followers and store categories (first page), and the store's products with price, discount, rating and link. Search inside the store with `q`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/lazada-shop

parameters.name: shop
parameters.description: Store name from a Lazada store link (lazada.sg/shop/<name>), or the link itself.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Lazada site: sg (default), my, th, ph, vn, id.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words inside the store (default: all products).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: popularity (default), price_asc or price_desc.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Lowest price, whole units of the local currency.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Highest price, whole units of the local currency.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; it is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
